theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (S : ℕ → Set (Rn n)), (∀ (m : ℕ) (ψ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono ψ → ∃ (χ : ℕ → ℕ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), StrictMono χ ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => F (ψ (χ j))) g atTop (S m)) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (V : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => F (φ j)) V atTop (S m)
